name: soleon-builder
description: The Soleon agent build loop. Everything in soleon-observer, plus: create and update agent drafts, deploy and promote agents, bind channels, and author custom MCP servers and knowledge bases. Includes the deploy-agent skill, which converts a local Claude Code agent identity (.claude/agents/<name>.md) into a validated, deploy-ready POST /agents request via an Allium specification. Distill, elicit gaps, and validate fully offline; then deploy the confirmed assets via the Soleon MCP server.

server_url.title: Soleon MCP server URL
server_url.description: Which Soleon system to connect to. Defaults to the dev system, which works out of the box. This is the only setting involved: the plugin carries no other environment-specific value, so changing this URL is sufficient to point at another Soleon system. That system must be running a current release (see the plugin README).
